info.title: Itinbee Backend API
info.description: OTA-agnostic, WhatsApp-native, offline-first collaborative trip workspace API, HLC delta-sync engine, Indian ticket ingestion pipeline, and UPI expense ledger.

get.summary: Render singapore health check for store & pubsub readiness

post.summary: Create or reuse an anonymous guest session (idempotent per cookie/bearer token)
Request an email magic code / sign-in link (Resend or SMTP in prod; includes dev preview in non-prod)
Verify email magic code, sign in, and automatically merge any active guest trips
Verify Google ID token (or devEmail in local dev when GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is unset) and merge guest trips

get.summary: Current session status (unauthenticated, guest, or signed-in user with owner UPI VPA)

patch.summary: Update user profile (display name, preferred language, UPI VPA)

post.summary: Clear session cookie, instruct browser to clear site storage, and sign out

get.summary: List only trips owned or joined by the current caller (excludes uncloned sample templates)

post.summary: Request a 6-digit phone OTP when claiming sandbox or syncing across devices
Verify phone OTP and issue bearer/cookie session token
Removed legacy endpoint — use POST /v1/auth/google/verify with OIDC idToken

delete.summary: DPDPA 2023 self-service erasure of user account & encrypted PII

get.summary: List curated sample/template itineraries and user workspaces

post.summary: Create a new collaborative trip workspace (auto-provisions guest session if unauthenticated)
Atomically migrate a local IndexedDB zero-signup sandbox draft into a cloud-synced trip

get.summary: Fetch full collaborative trip workspace (vault fields unlocked only for vault_access members)

patch.summary: Update trip title, destination summary, dates, or Elder comfort mode

post.summary: Add a co-traveller or companion member (with optional dietary tags & encrypted UPI VPA)

patch.summary: Update a co-traveller role, vault access, dietary tags, display name, or UPI VPA

delete.summary: Remove a co-traveller from the trip (cannot remove the last owner)

post.summary: Create a 7-day co-editor / viewer invitation link (with optional email delivery)

get.summary: Preview a co-editor trip invitation token

post.summary: Accept a co-editor trip invite (reuses signed-in session or provisions guest)

get.summary: Download decrypted ticket attachment (requires vault_access = true)

delete.summary: Delete a booking and purge its encrypted document from the vault

get.summary: Redacted <150KB WhatsApp Guest & Family/Elder Card projection (always redact_pii = true)
Fetch complete offline PWA bundle + regional Protomaps .pmtiles slice hint
Check transport status (static parsed view on Free; quota-capped licensed B2B feed on Trip Pass/Pro; zero scraping)
Issue a 2-minute signed WebSocket ticket for live co-editing rooms

post.summary: HLC + fractional-index delta-sync batch push/pull (idempotent client_op_id, monotonic server_seq, orphan-to-shortlist rule)
3-Stage Hybrid Ingestion for pasted IRCTC/flight/bus/stay SMS, confirmation emails, or Hinglish notes
Upload compressed booking PDF/image: masks Aadhaar, AES-256-GCM envelope-encrypts into R2/S3 or PostgreSQL vault, and parses booking
Extract geo-grounded Shortlist Idea Cards from Instagram Reel / YouTube Short oEmbed & caption (zero scraping)
HMAC-verified Cloudflare Email Routing webhook for forwarded confirmations to trips@itinbee.com
HMAC-verified WhatsApp Cloud API webhook for forwarded tickets & social links

get.summary: 100% Open-Data POI Search (Overture / Foursquare OS / OSM Photon / Wikidata — zero Google Places API calls)

post.summary: India-calibrated transit estimator (18 km/h metro peak, 1.9x @ 22 km/h hill switchbacks, zero-key Google Maps api=1 URL)

get.summary: Destination/place typeahead: local destinations (instant) merged with cached Photon (OSM) results. Debounce >= 250 ms.
List destinations (countries, states, regions, cities, areas). `tree=true` returns the full nested hierarchy.
Destination profile: summary, hero image, breadcrumb, children and Destination Pack status
Ranked places for a destination. Pack ready: served instantly (200). Pack missing/stale: a build is enqueued and a 202 payload with live Wikipedia fallback results is returned.

post.summary: Enqueue a Destination Pack (re)build. Requires the ADMIN_TOKEN (x-admin-token header or Bearer).

force.description: Rebuild even if the pack is ready/fresh

get.summary: Destination Pack build status (none | building | ready | stale) and last build statistics

post.summary: Route polyline + distance + duration via OpenRouteService (cached by coordinate hash). Falls back to the India transit estimator (`source: "estimate"`, straight-line geometry).

get.summary: Browse curated templates and user-published itineraries with hierarchical destination, duration, type, budget, and month filters
Fetch full day-by-day public itinerary detail for an Explore template or published trip

post.summary: Clone an Explore itinerary into a new editable trip draft owned by the caller (creates guest session if needed)
Publish a user trip into the public Explore catalogue
Start an asynchronous Smart Import job from messy text, WhatsApp chats, URLs, or ticket PDFs/screenshots

get.summary: Poll current Smart Import job state (fallback for environments without SSE)
Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream) for Smart Import: replays full job history on connect, then streams live events with 15s heartbeats

post.summary: Confirm (and optionally edit) extracted TripIntent + clarifying answers to build the grounded day-by-day itinerary (idempotent)
Ask Itinbee read-only assistant: proposes grounded add/move/remove/update operations without mutating the trip directly
Create a group consensus poll for stays, dates, or restaurants
Zero-OTP WhatsApp guest poll vote gated by Cloudflare Turnstile + guest_session_hash deduplication
Create an upfront shared trip cash/UPI Kitty Pool
Append an expense, compensating adjustment, or UPI settlement to the trip ledger

delete.summary: Delete an expense from the trip ledger and recompute kitty pool balances

get.summary: Compute min-cash-flow simplified debts and NPCI-aware UPI settlement payloads (restricted to trip members)
